## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List commands/tests run and their results. Explain anything not tested.

## Data and compatibility

Describe changes to raster alignment, band order, units, masks, checkpoint format,
dependencies or output behavior. State whether existing workflows are affected.

- [ ] Tests cover meaningful changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the change.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, large raster files or model weights are included.
- [ ] Accuracy claims identify their reference data, baseline and limitations.
